excerpt: 'The laboratory encompasses three main halls (named A, B and C), each about 100 x 20 x 18 m3... The rock overburden of the laboratory is about 3100 m w.e. (minimum depth), or 3800 m w.e. (average depth).' Also gives Modane (Main Hall 30x10x11 m3; Gamma Spectrometry Hall 70 m2; two secondary halls 18/21 m2), Canfranc (old lab: 3 small halls, ~140 m2 total; new lab: Hall A 40x15x12 m3/600 m2, Hall B 15x10x8 m3/150 m2), Boulby (total underground area ~1500 m2, ~1100 m depth, vertical shaft access) and Baksan (two parallel horizontal tunnels each 4 km long into Mt Andyrchi; BUST Hall 24x24x16 m3, ~850 m w.e.; SAGE hall 60x10x12 m3, 4800 m w.e. vertical depth; 'Neutrino' village at the entrance).
